title: Cash flow and break-even
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: own exam-style questions, case data and mark-scheme points (teacher-written))
intro: Lesson 45. Show your working for every calculation. All businesses, people and figures in these cases are fictional, made up for practice.

questions.q: In which month is the business most at risk? Explain.
questions.a: January: the closing balance falls to £0, so it cannot pay any unexpected bill.

blocks.text: Fixed costs £18,000 a year. Selling price £15 a cake box. Variable cost £9 a box. Expected sales 3,800 boxes.

questions.q: The price rises to £16. Calculate the new break-even output.
